meta.description: Registry for bounded infinite-iteration stability conditions and candidate modes in Phase 3.

asymptotic_stability_entries.name: Infinite Iteration Stability
asymptotic_stability_entries.purpose: Represent bounded asymptotic stabilization behavior under infinite recursive continuation systems.

infinite_iteration_conditions.name: asymptotic_stability_behavior_remains_detectable
infinite_iteration_conditions.description: Formal support for detecting long-term stabilization trends beyond finite simulation horizons.

infinite_iteration_conditions.name: recursive_iteration_updates_remain_bounded
infinite_iteration_conditions.description: The sequence of admissibility-preserving updates must not lead to state or flux divergence at infinity.

infinite_iteration_conditions.name: infinite_iteration_does_not_force_global_convergence
infinite_iteration_conditions.description: Asymptotic stability does not imply the existence of a unique, globally attracting fixed point.

infinite_iteration_conditions.name: selection_induced_branching_remains_admissible_under_iteration
infinite_iteration_conditions.description: Branching structures must satisfy admissibility windows at every step of the infinite sequence.

infinite_iteration_conditions.name: transport_flux_under_asymptotic_iteration_remains_finite
infinite_iteration_conditions.description: The limit of accumulated transport flux as iterations approach infinity must be formally bounded.

infinite_iteration_conditions.name: recursive_basin_instability_remains_detectable
infinite_iteration_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to register when an infinite chain escapes its local recurrence basin.

infinite_iteration_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_asymptotic_witness
infinite_iteration_conditions.description: Pruning of divergent paths at long horizons must not eliminate all possible asymptotic continuation witnesses.

infinite_iteration_conditions.name: infinite_iteration_divergence_modes_remain_classifiable
infinite_iteration_conditions.description: Breakdown in asymptotic stability must map to registered divergence failure modes.
